research_scope: Public Foodpanda outlet delivery menus matched to exact SFA directory licence, street address, unit and postal code. Proposed only menu labels, sections, sizes and published delivery prices. No images, paid services, API calls, logins, orders, or workbook edits.

outlets.branch_crosswalk: Foodpanda page footer identifies 161 Bukit Merah Central #01-3725 and postal 150161 (lines 916-921); workbook row W80052C000 has the same street, unit and postal code. This listing is an outlet-specific late-night delivery menu.
outlets.page_observation: Opened 2026-10-19; search index crawled today. Current menu categories/products and prices are visible. Listing is time-window/delivery scoped; do not treat as dine-in prices or all-day availability.
outlets.confidence: High for exact outlet identity and displayed item labels/prices; delivery discounts and availability are time-sensitive. Workbook public-access status remains candidate rather than independently verified.

limitations: Only newly proposed items for the exact licence records are included; no rows are copied to other branches.
Foodpanda delivery menus and prices can differ from in-store menus and can change with delivery time, promotions, selected options, or account context.
No source-provided image URLs were incorporated; menu images are outside this proposal.

The two workbook records remain marked public_access_candidate_based_on_sfa_type_and_address; Foodpanda listings support operational public availability but do not independently confirm every access condition.
